description.value: Burnaby Mountain Restaurant is a city-operated sit-down dining venue at Burnaby Mountain, a popular recreational hub with hiking and cycling trails overlooking the Lower Mainland. It is managed by Burnaby Hospitality alongside several other restaurants and event venues across Burnaby, and the mountain setting makes it one of the few full-service restaurant options near the summit. For cyclists who climb Burnaby Mountain — a well-known local challenge — this is a natural mid-ride or post-ride destination.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Burnaby Mountain Restaurant is an active listing within the Burnaby Hospitality group (foodburnaby.ca), appearing in site navigation and described in the 'Dine with Us' section as situated 'among rolling hills and majestic trees.' The OSM phone (+1-604-297-4888) is corroborated by the truncated website footer ('604-297-48...'). No cycling-specific amenities — bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or takeout — are mentioned anywhere in the fetched website content, so all amenity fields remain null; the OSM community tag reads 'North Vancouver' but all evidence (address, operator branding) places this firmly in Burnaby.
concerns: OSM community tag is 'North Vancouver' but the restaurant is at 7600 Halifax Street, Burnaby — this is a tagging error.
Website footer contact address (9001 Bill Fox Way, Burnaby, BC V5J 5J3) is the Burnaby Hospitality corporate HQ and does not corroborate the OSM restaurant address of 7600 Halifax Street.

The fetched website page for this restaurant contains no restaurant-specific content — only site-wide navigation and group-level marketing copy — making amenity verification impossible without a direct visit or phone call.
